name: ClinicalTrials.gov
description: Registry of clinical studies; filter by condition "Multiple Sclerosis" for trial designs, status and posted results
notes: If you share data: credit ClinicalTrials.gov, show the date it was processed, describe any changes and keep it current. Copyright applies outside the US, and some records may carry third-party copyright. Has an API for bulk queries.

name: PubMed
license: NLM policies; abstracts are copyrighted by publishers
description: Index of biomedical papers on MS
notes: Cite papers by PMID or DOI; don't copy full abstracts

name: Atlas of MS (MS International Federation)
license: Copyright MSIF; permission needed to reproduce
description: Country-level MS prevalence and incidence, plus figures on diagnosis and care resources
notes: Downloads are allowed where the site offers them. Ask MSIF before reproducing material. Cite individual figures instead of copying tables.

name: Global Burden of Disease results (IHME)
description: Modelled MS prevalence, incidence, deaths and DALYs by country, age and sex
notes: Non-commercial use only. Don't copy or redistribute the downloaded data without written consent; your own analyses and results can be published with a citation.

name: GWAS Catalog
license: EMBL-EBI terms of use; summary statistics CC0 unless stated otherwise
description: Published genome-wide association results, including MS risk variants
notes: Check each study's Usage License column before copying summary statistics

name: International MS Genetics Consortium (IMSGC)
description: Consortium behind the largest MS genetic studies
notes: A 2024 preprint says summary statistics are available through imsgc.net. Individual-level data is controlled (dbGaP phs000139). Some cohorts' summary statistics are only available on request. A Zenodo copy exists but isn't an official IMSGC release.

name: Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)
license: No NCBI restrictions; submitters may claim rights
description: Public gene expression and other omics datasets; search "multiple sclerosis"
notes: Sample-level data; check each dataset and its paper for submitter terms

name: OpenNeuro
license: CC0 for new datasets and versions; some older ones are CC-BY or PDDL
description: Open neuroimaging datasets, some including people with MS

name: DailyMed (US drug labels)
license: NLM content is a US government work; label text comes from manufacturers
description: Official US prescribing information for MS disease-modifying therapies, including summaries of key trials
notes: Copyright status of the label text itself is unclear; openFDA offers the same label data

name: EMA European public assessment reports
license: EMA copyright; reproduction allowed with the source credited
description: EU regulatory assessments of MS medicines, with trial evidence
notes: Third-party material and the EMA logo need separate permission

name: MS Data Alliance catalogue
description: Catalogue of MS data sources such as registries and cohorts worldwide
notes: The old msdataalliance.com address doesn't respond. A 2021 paper (DOI 10.7224/1537-2073.2021-006) says authorized users can browse metadata profiles.

name: MSBase
description: International long-term registry of people with MS
notes: Membership is free for researchers; data is requested through the MSBase portal. Private space only; never commit data.

name: NARCOMS
description: North American registry of patient-reported MS data
notes: Its homepage says the data is made available to researchers; the request process isn't confirmed. Private space only; never commit data.

name: UK MS Register
description: UK register that combines patient-reported and clinical MS data
notes: Proposals need approval from the Register's Scientific Steering Committee. Anonymised data is accessed in the SAIL Databank, typically 2-6 months after approval. Private space only; never commit data.

name: UK Biobank
description: Large UK cohort that includes participants with MS
notes: New applications are paused; the site expects to reopen them in late 2026. Private space only; never commit data.
